hero.title: Haidara Muhanned
hero.description: I build practical software systems and applications from requirements to a usable product, with a strong focus on backend engineering, implementation quality, and adapting to what each project needs.

about.title: About me
about.paragraphOne: I am Haidara Muhanned, a backend-focused software developer and a third-year Computer Engineering Techniques student at the University of Al-Kafeel. I enjoy building software that solves real problems, from understanding requirements and shaping data to implementation, testing, and delivering a usable product.
about.paragraphTwo: Learning is a core part of how I work. When a project needs something outside my primary specialization, I learn what the solution requires and integrate it into the product. That has led me to work across interfaces, databases, testing, Git, GitHub, and other supporting areas. I also enjoy reinforcing what I learn by explaining technical concepts to others.

projectsSection.title: My projects
projectsSection.description: Four practical products for four different contexts. Understand what each one does, try its simulation here, or open the complete project details.

projects.title: Enterprise Workflow
projects.summary: A system for internal requests and approvals usually handled through paper and email, with dynamic workflows, permissions, notifications, and an audit trail for each action.
projects.resumeSummary: An internal requests and approval system with permissions, notifications, and an audit trail.

projects.title: Coding Academy
projects.summary: An Arabic practice-first platform that begins with clear lesson and summary cards, then moves into examples, exercises, and projects while keeping progress on the learner's device.
projects.previewAlt: Coding Academy lesson and summary cards
projects.resumeSummary: An Arabic learning platform combining lesson cards, examples, exercises, and locally saved progress.

projects.title: Mahsoob
projects.summary: An Arabic offline point-of-sale system for groceries, minimarkets, and small Iraqi shops, designed around cashier speed, IQD, and uninterrupted daily work.
projects.previewAlt: Source-faithful simulation of the Mahsoob checkout
projects.resumeSummary: An offline-first Arabic point-of-sale system designed around cashier flow and Iraqi dinar workflows.

projects.title: Masroofi
projects.summary: A personal Arabic app for recording income and expenses and tracking the balance instantly, with local storage plus data backup and restore without requiring an account.
projects.resumeSummary: A personal income and expense tracker with local storage, backup, and restore workflows.
